data.body: **[P2] Finish context end hooks before resetting invocation state.** When a context end races with provider-flush completion, this `await` yields after exporting and removing its last pending child, but before recording the context span. `onInvocationEnd()` can then observe an empty pending map and reset the invocation. This hook resumes past its entry guard with cleared trace identity and a `NOT_RECORD` sampling decision, dropping the parent and leaving the exported child referencing a missing span. Make child draining and parent finalization synchronous, or settle in-flight end hooks before resetting state. Apply the same protection to the analogous invocation-view drain, and add a regression where flush completion interleaves with this await.
